name: xiaoli-ui
description: Xiaoli UI — React + Vue 双框架 Web 组件库（M1 试点）

scripts.docs:dev: echo "文档门户尚未建立，请先使用 playground：pnpm dev:react / pnpm dev:vue" && exit 0
scripts.typecheck: pnpm tokens:generate && pnpm --filter @xiaoli-ui/tokens exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @xiaoli-ui/react typecheck && pnpm --filter @xiaoli-ui/vue typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: echo "Playwright e2e 尚未接入（not-run）" && exit 0
scripts.test:a11y: echo "axe 自动化尚未接入（not-run）" && exit 0
scripts.build: pnpm tokens:generate && pnpm --filter @xiaoli-ui/tokens build && pnpm --filter @xiaoli-ui/theme build && pnpm --filter @xiaoli-ui/react build && pnpm --filter @xiaoli-ui/vue build
scripts.size:check: echo "体积预算检查将在稳定范围扩大后启用（not-run）" && exit 0
scripts.release:verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:contract && pnpm build && pnpm pack:check
scripts.release:publish: echo "禁止擅自发布。请所有者按 docs/19 授权后再执行。" && exit 1
